videos.desc: An animated waitress at an outdoor restaurant folds a white napkin into an elegant fan shape and presents it on a plate with a proud 'Ta-da'. She then tastes soup, dabs her mouth with a napkin, tucks one into her collar and sits down happily.
videos.said: (upbeat music) Ta-da! Oops.

videos.desc: A cartoon man at a beach bar stretches a striped bendy straw, drops it into his iced juice and slurps the whole glass empty through it in seconds; he turns the empty glass upside down and proudly points the straw at the camera.
videos.said: (upbeat music) (water bubbling) (sighs)

videos.desc: In an orchard a woman picks a big dark-red apple from the tree, polishes it on a cloth and bites into it with delight; later she and a friend slice it in half on a tree stump and each eat a piece.
videos.said: Follow your shine. So crisp.

videos.desc: A cartoon man with sunglasses and a moustache packs apples, a baguette, a sandwich and a water bottle into a big tan bag on a picnic blanket; an apple drops out, he picks it up, puts it back and closes the bag.
videos.said: Oops! Got it!

videos.desc: On a tropical balcony a man picks a banana from a hanging bunch, and a woman shows him how to open it; he pinches the bottom end, peels it, takes a bite and grins at the camera.
videos.said: Flip it, pinch! Works every time!

videos.desc: In a beer garden a man pours a bottle of golden beer into a tilted glass, straightens it for a perfect foam head and levels the foam with a knife, then clinks glasses with a woman at a picnic table and they drink.
videos.said: Tilt and straighten in. Perfect foam.

videos.desc: A cartoon boy with glasses takes a blue bowl down from the kitchen cupboard, pours in cereal and milk, then lifts the bowl with both hands and drinks the last milk straight from it.
videos.said: Yum, yum, yum!

videos.desc: Two bakers pull a golden round loaf out of a wood-fired stone oven on a wooden peel, knock on the crust to check it, then tear the warm bread open with steam rising from the soft inside and taste it.
videos.said: Hollow, perfect. Still warm.

videos.desc: A couple in pajamas makes breakfast at sunrise: they fry eggs, butter the toast, drizzle honey on porridge with berries and pour orange juice, then carry it all outside and eat together at a garden table while a rooster struts by.
videos.said: Morning! That's hot.

videos.desc: At an outdoor evening grill a man fries a beef patty, melts cheese on it and stacks a tall burger with lettuce, tomato, sauce and onion rings; a young woman grabs it with both hands and takes big happy bites.
videos.said: Stack it high. Both hands worth it.

videos.desc: A woman tries to spread butter straight from the fridge and the hard lump tears a hole right through the bread slice, which she shows to the camera outraged; the couple softens the butter by the toaster and she then spreads it smoothly and eats the toast happily.
videos.said: Too hard, look! Now it melts.

videos.desc: At a birthday party a woman in a paper crown blows out the candles on a cream cake decorated with berries while her friends cheer; they cut thick slices and everyone digs in together.
videos.said: Make a wish! First life, mine!

videos.desc: In a kitchen a man pours cornflakes into a bowl and insists on eating them dry, crunching loudly, while a red-haired woman pours milk into her bowl; he tries the milk version too and they both eat their cereal.
videos.said: Dry first! Listen! Now the milk.

videos.desc: In a chalet kitchen a woman cuts a wedge from a whole wheel of cheese and bites into it; then she and a man grate cheese, fry grilled cheese sandwiches and pull the halves apart to show the long stretchy cheese strings.
videos.said: Wait for it. Wait. The stretch!

videos.desc: On a seaside pier a woman unwraps a pink stick of chewing gum, pops it in her mouth, chews and then blows a big pink bubble; the man beside her takes a piece and blows a bubble too.
videos.said: (upbeat music) - Minty! (upbeat music)

videos.desc: A couple on a park bench bite sticky caramel candies on sticks and chew with exaggerated effort, their jaws straining as the toffee stretches and glues their teeth, while a squirrel watches from the bench.
videos.said: One, two, three! I'm going! Round two!

videos.desc: In a winter cabin a man snaps a chocolate bar into squares with a crisp snap, lets one melt in his mouth, then melts chocolate in a pot and pours it over a bowl of strawberries, which he shares with a woman.
videos.said: That's snap. Perfect. Mmm, gone. Just melted.

videos.desc: In an animated lantern-lit dumpling restaurant a girl shows a boy how to hold chopsticks in his hand. He practices the grip slowly, finally picks a steamed dumpling from the bamboo basket with them, eats it and both cheer.
videos.said: Hold them like this slowly slowly. Oh, I did it

videos.desc: A yawning, half-asleep man shuffles into the kitchen and brews coffee in a moka pot on the stove. He pours the dark coffee into a cup, takes one sip and his eyes snap wide open - instantly awake, he salutes and marches off ready for the day.
videos.said: Ugh, can't function. Awake, let's go!

videos.desc: A young woman takes a tray of chocolate-chunk cookies out of the oven, holds one up to the camera, dunks it in her hot drink counting "one, two, three, out", then eats cookies at the table with a friend while a cat sleeps on the windowsill.
videos.said: One, two, three, out! It's gone.

videos.desc: In a kitchen a man snaps a cucumber in half with a loud crack, peels it over a bowl and cuts it into thin round slices; a woman then holds two slices over her eyes like at a spa before eating one, and the slices are tossed into a salad.
videos.said: snap hear that so cool

videos.desc: At a wooden tea table, hot tea is poured from a clay teapot into a small green ceramic cup; a woman lifts the warm cup in her hands, sips from it and smiles at the man sitting across from her.
videos.said: A warm little hug.

videos.desc: A young couple lounging with their cat jumps up excitedly and races down the hallway when the doorbell rings. A helmeted courier at the rainy doorstep hands them boxes of hot food, and they hurry back to the couch to open the steaming takeout and eat.
videos.said: It's here! Go go! It's still hot!

videos.desc: On a candlelit seaside terrace at dusk, a woman carries a steaming pot to a set table with salad, bread and plates, calling everyone over. Friends gather, serve the stew, pass bread, raise their glasses in a toast, and eat together under string lights.
videos.said: It's ready! Come! To us!

videos.desc: A thirsty man staggers up to a street fruit stand where a vendor squeezes oranges into a tall glass. He gulps the fresh juice down in one go, sighs with relief, and happily asks for another while a parrot watches from the stand.
videos.said: so so thirsty ah another

videos.desc: A couple on tiny plastic stools at an Asian night-market stall lift noodles, greens and broth to their mouths from big soup bowls, slurping happily. They eat everything, the woman even drinks straight from the bowl, and both pat comically swollen full bellies at the end.
videos.said: Mmm so good Completely full

videos.desc: On a beach at sunset, a man grills a whole fish in a wire basket over glowing coals next to a fishing boat, then squeezes lemon over it. A woman lifts a flaky white piece with a fork, tastes it and closes her eyes with delight.
videos.said: From the sea! Look! White! It flakes!

videos.desc: At a long wooden table in a stone-walled courtyard, friends share a big spread of food: fresh flatbread torn open, steaming meat stew ladled onto plates, dumplings, white cheese, grapes and pomegranates. They dip bread in the stew, pass plates around and eat together, saying 'So much, look! Dig in!'
videos.said: So much, look! Dig in!

videos.desc: At a candlelit restaurant table, a woman holds a silver fork up to the camera, then twirls a huge coil of spaghetti onto it while her date watches wide-eyed. She proudly lifts the loaded fork, eats the pasta, and then spears salad leaves and a cherry tomato with it, saying 'Twirl, twirl, twirl. Not one noodle lost.'
videos.said: Twirl, twirl, twirl. Not one noodle lost.

videos.desc: At an outdoor food stand by a canal, a vendor lowers a basket of pale potato sticks into bubbling oil. He lifts out golden crispy fries, fills a white paper cone, sprinkles salt over them, and a customer in a beanie blows on a hot fry and eats it with delight, saying 'Crispy! Perfect!'
videos.said: Easy. In they go. Crispy! Perfect!

videos.desc: A young woman at an open-air market stall admires a mango, hanging bananas and grapes, fills her basket with a pineapple and oranges, then happily bites into a peach saying it is juicy.
videos.said: One of each! So juicy!

videos.desc: On a sunny tiled terrace, a woman peers through an empty glass joking "I can see you!", fills it with ice cubes and fresh lemonade, hooks a lemon slice on the rim and drinks; she and a friend clink their glasses.
videos.said: I can see you! Ah, ice cold!

videos.desc: On a seaside terrace at sunset a couple watches thick golden honey drip slowly from a wooden dipper into a jar, drizzles it over a slice of toast with cream, and the man licks a sticky finger and happily eats a piece.
videos.said: - Slow, look at it go. - Whoa! Stuck. Worth it.

videos.desc: At a sunny seaside stand a vendor hands a man a tall cone with scoops of vanilla and strawberry ice cream; as it starts melting down his hand he licks it frantically while his girlfriend holds her own cone and laughs.
videos.said: Beat it. Barely.

videos.desc: At a sunny breakfast table a woman opens a jar of dark berry jam, lifts a dripping spoonful, spreads it thickly across a slice of toast bread and tastes it while her partner watches happily.
videos.said: To the edges!

videos.desc: In a sunny courtyard a man halves a pomegranate, presses it in a hand juicer so ruby-red juice streams into a glass, then drinks it and shares a glass with a woman under the pomegranate tree.
videos.said: Look at that color. Pure fruit. Wow.

videos.desc: In a retro diner a man shakes and smacks a stubborn glass ketchup bottle over a plate of fries until the ketchup finally pours out in a big red pool; he dips a fry and eats it, delighted.
videos.said: - Come on, come on. - There it goes.

videos.desc: Under a lemon tree by the sea, a woman cuts a lemon into wedges; she and a man each bite one and pull twisted sour faces, then squeeze the juice into a jug with sugar and ice and toast with fresh lemonade.
videos.said: Just one lick. Sour, so sour!
